text:
jamie: Heads-up — I'm updating the tenant rehome section in SOC2 docs. Need quick alignment on retention phrasing and an SDK example for migrating audit logs when a customer requests tenant rehoming. Draft below, please sanity-check.

jamie: Draft phrasing: "When a customer requests tenant rehoming, Redwood will export tenant-scoped audit logs and associated records for migration. Exports are retained in encrypted storage for up to 30 days while in transit; permanent retention is controlled by the destination tenant. Sensitive fields may be pseudonymized or redacted unless the customer provides documented consent for a full export." Thoughts?

naren: Quick read. Change "up to 30 days" to "up to 30 days unless otherwise specified in an agreement" for SOC2 clarity. Also add a line about KMS ownership for Private deployments.

taylor: Agreed. Docs should include a tiny JSONL sample and a short curl + Python streaming snippet. Keep it minimal and link to the streaming export guide.

ashley: From eng: migration jobs stream newline-delimited JSONL. Call out ordering guarantees: ordering is preserved per-source-partition but not globally. Also recommend consumers use a streaming client and backpressure.

jamie: Revised: "Exports are streamed as encrypted newline-delimited JSONL and retained in encrypted storage for up to 30 days while in transit, unless otherwise specified in an SLA. For Private deployments, customers may elect to manage KMS keys."

naren: That works. For legal, replace "sensitive fields may be pseudonymized or redacted" with "sensitive fields may be pseudonymized or redacted per customer configuration and in accordance with Redwood's data minimization procedures." Adds needed flexibility.

taylor: I'll add the snippets. Proposed curl example for the migration API:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: application/jsonl" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/:source_tenant/exports/auditlogs?stream=true" \
  -o auditlogs.jsonl
```

And a tiny Python streaming example using requests for the playbook.

ashley: +1, include a footnote: "Ordering guarantees: preserved per-partition; consumers should not assume global ordering across partitions." Also mention retry/idempotency guidance for resumable transfers.

docs-bot: PR #4021 opened against docs/soc2 with draft changes. Add @naren and @taylor as reviewers.

jamie: @taylor paste final commit wording so legal can sign off.

taylor: Commit-ready wording:

"When a customer requests tenant rehoming, Redwood streams tenant-scoped audit events as encrypted newline-delimited JSONL. Exports are stored encrypted and retained for up to 30 days by default while in transit; customers may request extended retention via SLA. Sensitive fields may be pseudonymized or redacted per customer configuration and in accordance with Redwood's data minimization procedures. For Private deployments, customers can elect to manage KMS keys. See the Tenant Rehoming Playbook and Streaming Export reference for details and example SDK snippets. To request extended retention, contact support@redwood.ai and open a support ticket; extended retention requires a documented agreement."

naren: LGTM from legal once the support link is added.

taylor: Adding support link and a short note on the SLA process in the PR.

ashley: I'm adding a short engineering note in the playbook: use the export's sequence_id and partition_id fields to resume and validate ordering; do not assume global ordering.

jamie: Great. Merge once PR has snippets, support link, and the KMS sentence. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR #4021 updated with fixes and ready for review.

taylor: Reviewing now, expect tiny anchor fixes.

naren: Approved after fixes.

jamie: Merged. Closing thread.
